release_notes:
Fix payment crediting: crash on first-time payments, and a broken manual approval

- Every payment gateway (PayPal, Stripe, Wise, Binance, PayerURL, and
  invoice-based payments) could fail with a fatal error when crediting
  a customer's very first payment, because a brand-new account's credit
  balance is stored as empty rather than zero. The payment would still
  be captured by the gateway, but the credit-adding step would crash
  partway through, leaving the invoice stuck instead of completed.
- The admin "Mark invoices as Paid" bulk action only changed an
  invoice's status label — it never actually added the credits to the
  customer's account, so using it on a stuck invoice left the customer
  paid but still showing a $0 balance for that payment. It now adds
  the credits correctly, the same way the single-invoice approval
  screen does, and can't double-credit an invoice that's already been
  processed.
